subject: DI02005011

body.en:
Definition

A unit operation is a physical processing step such as separation, mixing or heat-driven phase change.Stoichiometric calculations relate material amounts consistently; reaction stoichiometry uses balanced chemical equations when reaction actually occurs.

Classification / basis

  • Mechanical separation:filtration; contact/mass-transfer separations:distillation, absorption, extraction, leaching; moisture/solvent removal:drying, evaporation; other duties:mixing, crystallization.
  • Most listed operations need nonreactive mass/component balances, not invented reaction equations.If reaction is specified, coefficients give mole ratios, not directly mass ratios.
  • Choose a system boundary, basis and conserved component.Stream mass flow=total mass flow×component mass fraction.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Separation, mixing કે heat-driven phase change જેવી physical processing step unit operation છે.Stoichiometric ગણતરીઓ amountsને સુસંગત જોડે; reaction થાય ત્યારે balanced equationના coefficients વપરાય.

વર્ગીકરણ / આધાર

  • Mechanical separation:filtration; contact/mass-transfer:distillation, absorption, extraction, leaching; moisture/solvent removal:drying, evaporation; other:mixing, crystallization.
  • આ listed operationsમાં સામાન્ય રીતે nonreactive mass/component balance જોઈએ, બનાવટી reaction નહીં.Reaction specified હોય તો coefficients mole ratios આપે, mass ratios સીધાં નહીં.
  • System boundary, basis/conserved component પસંદ કરો.Component mass flow=total flow×mass fraction.

title.en: General material balance and degrees of freedom
title.gu: General Material Balance તથા Degrees of Freedom

h.en: General material balance and degrees of freedom
h.gu: General Material Balance તથા Degrees of Freedom

body.en:
Definition

A material balance accounts for the accumulation, entry, exit, generation and consumption of material inside a defined system boundary.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Defined boundaryમાં materialનું accumulation, in, out, generation તથા consumption ગણવું material balance છે.

h.en: Direct derivation: General material balance and degrees of freedom
h.gu: સીધી તારવણી: General Material Balance તથા Degrees of Freedom

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. General component balance:Accumulation=In−Out+Generation−Consumption.
  2. For a nonreactive component, generation=consumption=0.At steady state accumulation=0, so Σin ṁxi=Σout ṁxi.
  3. Total mass is conserved even in ordinary reactions; total moles need not be.Total steady mass balance is Σṁin=Σṁout.
  4. For a binary nonreactive separator, F=P1+P2 and Fz=P1x1+P2x2.Only two of total plus two component balances are independent.
  5. Degrees of freedom=unknown independent variables−independent equations.Check specification sufficiency before numerical substitution.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. General component balance:Accumulation=In−Out+Generation−Consumption.
  2. Nonreactive componentમાં generation=consumption=0; steady stateમાં accumulation=0, અેથી Σin ṁxi=Σout ṁxi.
  3. Ordinary reactionsમાં total mass conserved રહે, total moles જરૂરી નહીં.Total steady mass balance Σṁin=Σṁout.
  4. Binary nonreactive separatorમાં F=P1+P2, Fz=P1x1+P2x2.Total+2component balancesમાંથી2જ independent.
  5. Degrees of freedom=independent unknowns−independent equations.Values મૂકતાં પહેલાં પૂરતી specifications છે કે નહીં તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Distillation separates liquid-mixture components by differences in volatility through vapour–liquid contacting.

Explanation and use

  • The feed F enters the column; vapour-rich material leaves through the overhead system as distillate D and less-volatile material as bottoms B.Internal reflux is inside the chosen overall boundary.
  • Use one consistent mass or molar composition basis.Overall balances alone calculate product quantities only when product compositions are supplied; they do not predict equilibrium separation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Volatilityના તફાવતથી vapour–liquid contacting દ્વારા liquid mixture અલગ પાડવી distillation છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Feed F columnમાં આવે; overheadથી distillate D અને less-volatile bottomથી B જાય.Internal reflux chosen overall boundaryની અંદર છે.
  • એક mass/molar basis લો.Product compositions આપ્યાં હોય ત્યારે balancesથી quantities મળે; balances પોતે equilibrium separation predict નથી કરતા.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. At steady state without loss, F=D+B.
  2. For selected component zF, xD, xB on one basis:FzF=DxD+BxB.
  3. Substitute B=F−D:D=F(zF−xB)/(xD−xB), then B=F−D.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Steady state/no lossમાં F=D+B.
  2. એક basisનાં selected component fractionsથી FzF=DxD+BxB.
  3. B=F−D મૂકતાં D=F(zF−xB)/(xD−xB); પછી B=F−D.

body.en:
Definition

Absorption transfers a soluble component from a gas into a liquid absorbent.

Explanation and use

  • Gas contacts incoming solvent, commonly countercurrently; solute-lean gas and solute-rich liquid leave separately.A carrier-gas/solute-free-solvent basis often avoids confusion from changing total stream rates.
  • Assume nonvolatile solvent, insoluble carrier gas and no reaction only when stated.These assumptions make carrier Gs and solvent Ls constant; total gas/liquid rates need not be constant.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Gasના soluble componentને liquid absorbentમાં transfer કરવું absorption છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Gas incoming solventને સામાન્ય રીતે countercurrently મળે; lean gas/rich liquid અલગ જાય.Changing total ratesમાં solute-free carrier/solvent basis ઉપયોગી છે.
  • Stated હોય ત્યારે જ nonvolatile solvent, insoluble carrier/no reaction માનો.તેથી Gs/Ls constant થાય, total gas/liquid rates જરૂરી નહીં.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. Define Y=solute mass/carrier mass and X=solute mass/solute-free solvent mass.
  2. At steady state, Gs(Yin−Yout)=Ls(Xout−Xin).
  3. For mole fractions, y→Y=y/(1−y) and x→X=x/(1−x) on a molar carrier basis; do not mix mass and molar ratios.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Y=solute mass/carrier mass, X=solute mass/solute-free solvent mass.
  2. Steady stateમાં Gs(Yin−Yout)=Ls(Xout−Xin).
  3. Molar carrier basisમાં Y=y/(1−y), X=x/(1−x); mass/molar ratios ભેળવશો નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Drying removes moisture from a wet solid, usually by transfer into a gas stream.

Explanation and use

  • Wet feed becomes a drier solid product while air/gas gains water vapour.Dry solid is a useful conserved basis if it is not lost, decomposed or volatilised.Drying is not the same as evaporating a bulk liquid solution.
  • Wet-basis moisture w=water/(water+dry solid); dry-basis moisture X=water/dry solid.These percentages have different denominators.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wet solidની moisture સામાન્ય રીતે gasમાં transfer કરીને દૂર કરવી drying છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Wet feed drier product બને અને gas water vapour લે.Dry solid loss/decomposition/volatilisation ન થાય તો conserved basis છે.Drying bulk liquid solutionનું evaporation નથી.
  • Wet basis w=water/(water+dry solid); dry basis X=water/dry solid.Denominators જુદાં છે.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. For wet-feed mass F, dry solids S=F(1−win).
  2. With conserved dry solid, product P=S/(1−wout); removed water W=F−P.
  3. Equivalently X=w/(1−w), so W=S(Xin−Xout).If gas data are given, Gdry(Yout−Yin)=W.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Wet-feed F માટે dry solids S=F(1−win).
  2. Dry solid conserved હોય તો P=S/(1−wout), removed water W=F−P.
  3. X=w/(1−w)થી W=S(Xin−Xout); gas dataમાં Gdry(Yout−Yin)=W.

body.en:
Definition

Extraction transfers a solute between partly immiscible liquid phases by contact with a suitable solvent.

Explanation and use

  • Feed F contacts solvent S and separates into extract E, rich in extracting solvent, and raffinate R, rich in original carrier.The extract is not automatically pure solute.
  • Balances require the compositions of the outlet phases or equivalent equilibrium/specification data.Assuming complete solvent immiscibility is a simplifying condition, not a universal property.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Suitable solvent સાથે contactથી partly immiscible liquid phases વચ્ચે solute transfer કરવું extraction છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Feed F solvent Sને મળે અને extracting-solvent-rich extract E/original-carrier-rich raffinate Rમાં અલગ થાય.Extract pure solute જરૂરી નથી.
  • Outlet compositions કે equivalent equilibrium/specification data જોઈએ.Complete solvent immiscibility simplifying condition છે, universal property નહીં.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. Overall steady balance:F+S=E+R.
  2. For solute:FzF+SzS=ExE+RxR; pure solute-free solvent has zS=0.
  3. Add carrier/solvent balances when needed and use only independent equations.Check all phase mass fractions sum to1.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Overall steady balance F+S=E+R.
  2. Solute balance FzF+SzS=ExE+RxR; pure solute-free solventમાં zS=0.
  3. જરૂર મુજબ carrier/solvent balances ઉમેરો; independent equations જ લો.Phase fractionsનો sum1 તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Leaching dissolves a soluble component from a solid mixture into a liquid solvent.

Explanation and use

  • A soluble solid component enters the liquid phase while insoluble solid forms residue.Leach liquor may leave as overflow, and some solution may remain with the wet residue; that retained solution contains solute and cannot always be ignored.
  • Define whether dissolution is complete and whether residue retains solution on a stated basis.An insoluble-solid balance provides an independent relation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Solid mixtureના soluble componentને liquid solventમાં dissolve કરવું leaching છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Soluble component liquidમાં જાય; insoluble solid residue બને.Overflow leach liquor તથા wet residueમાં retained solution હોય; તેમાં solute હોવાથી તેને હંમેશાં અવગણી ન શકાય.
  • Dissolution complete છે કે નહીં તથા residueમાં retained solutionનો basis સ્પષ્ટ કરો.Insoluble-solid balance independent relation આપે છે.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. Let feed F and solvent S form overflow L and wet residue R:F+S=L+R.
  2. Solute balance:FzF+SzS=LxL+RxR; insoluble solids are balanced separately.
  3. If well-mixed retained liquor is assumed, its solute fraction equals the separated liquid fraction; multiply by retained liquor mass, not total residue mass.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Feed F+solvent Sથી overflow L+wet residue R:F+S=L+R.
  2. Solute FzF+SzS=LxL+RxR; insoluble solidsનું અલગ balance કરો.
  3. Well-mixed retained liquorમાં solute fraction separated liquid જેટલો; retained liquor massથી ગુણો, total residue massથી નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Evaporation concentrates a solution by vaporising part of its solvent.

Explanation and use

  • Feed F splits into concentrated liquid L and solvent vapour V.A nonvolatile solute remains in liquid if entrainment and crystallisation are neglected.The heating steam is a separate utility stream, not automatically added to process liquid.
  • A material balance gives solvent removal; heating duty requires additional energy/property data not supplied by a mass balance alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Solventનો ભાગ vapour બનાવી solution concentrate કરવું evaporation છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Feed F concentrated L તથા solvent vapour V બને.Nonvolatile solute, no entrainment/crystallisationમાં liquidમાં રહે.Heating steam અલગ utility છે, process liquidમાં આપમેળે ઉમેરાતી નથી.
  • Material balance solvent removal આપે; heating duty માટે વધારાની energy/property data જોઈએ.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. F=L+V.
  2. For nonvolatile solute with mass fractions xF, xL:F xF=L xL.
  3. Therefore L=F xF/xL and V=F−L; check xL>xF for concentration.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. F=L+V.
  2. Nonvolatile soluteનાં mass fractionsથી F xF=L xL.
  3. અેથી L=F xF/xL, V=F−L; concentrationમાં xL>xF તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Filtration separates suspended solids from a fluid by a retaining porous medium.

Explanation and use

  • Slurry feed splits into filtrate and wet cake.The cake includes retained liquid as well as dry solids; it is not generally dry product.In a simple model all suspended solids remain in cake and filtrate is free of those solids.
  • Dissolved solutes travel with liquid and need a separate liquid-phase balance where relevant.Do not treat dissolved salt as automatically retained by ordinary filter cloth.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Retaining porous mediumથી fluidમાંથી suspended solids અલગ પાડવા filtration કહેવાય.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Slurry filtrate તથા wet cake બને.Cakeમાં dry solids ઉપરાંત retained liquid પણ હોય; તે dry product જરૂરી નથી.Simple modelમાં બધા suspended solids cakeમાં અને filtrateમાં solids નહીં.
  • Dissolved solutes liquid સાથે જાય અને જરૂર મુજબ liquid-phase balance જોઈએ.Ordinary cloth dissolved salt આપમેળે રોકે એવું ન માનો.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. Overall:F=C+Lfiltrate.
  2. If feed suspended-solid fraction is xF and cake moisture fraction wC, dry solid S=F xF=C(1−wC).
  3. Thus C=F xF/(1−wC), Lfiltrate=F−C.Check liquid retained in cake=CwC.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Overall F=C+Lfiltrate.
  2. Feed suspended-solid fraction xF, cake moisture wCમાં S=F xF=C(1−wC).
  3. અેથી C=F xF/(1−wC), Lfiltrate=F−C; retained liquid=CwC તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Mixing combines two or more feed streams to form a product with a specified overall composition.

Explanation and use

  • The boundary surrounds the mixer and all inlets/outlets.For a nonreactive steady batch-equivalent calculation, total and component mass balances determine the mixed composition.Volume additivity is not required for a mass balance.
  • Dilution adds solvent to reduce concentration without consuming solute.Do not average feed percentages without weighting by feed amounts.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે કે વધુ feed streamsને જોડીને specified overall compositionનું product બનાવવું mixing છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Boundary mixer/inlets/outletsને ઘેરે.Nonreactive steady/batch-equivalent calculationમાં total/component balancesથી composition મળે.Mass balance માટે volume additivity જરૂરી નથી.
  • Dilutionમાં solute consume કર્યા વિના solvent ઉમેરી concentration ઘટાડાય.Feed amountsથી weighting કર્યા વિના percentagesનું average ન લો.

h.en: Direct derivation: Mixing and dilution balance
h.gu: સીધી તારવણી: Mixing તથા Dilution Balance

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. For two mass streams:F1+F2=P.
  2. Component:F1x1+F2x2=PxP; hence xP=(F1x1+F2x2)/(F1+F2).
  3. For solvent addition x2=0; product solute mass remains F1x1.For molarity dilution, use final solution volume and solute mole conservation.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Two mass streamsમાં F1+F2=P.
  2. Component F1x1+F2x2=PxP; અેથી xP=(F1x1+F2x2)/(F1+F2).
  3. Solvent additionમાં x2=0; solute mass F1x1 રહે.Molarity dilutionમાં final solution volume/solute mole conservation લો.

body.en:
Definition

Crystallization produces a solid crystalline phase from a supersaturated solution, for example by cooling or solvent evaporation.

Explanation and use

  • The feed separates into crystals and mother liquor.For a simple cooling balance without evaporation and without crystal hydration, the crystals may be treated as pure solute and mother liquor as saturated solution at final T.
  • Solubility quoted as g solute/100g solvent must first become a solution fraction x=S/(100+S).Hydrated crystals or wet crystals require their actual solvent/retained-liquor content; pure-solute formulas then need modification.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Supersaturated solutionમાંથી cooling/solvent evaporationથી solid crystalline phase બનાવવું crystallization છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Simple cooling/no evaporation/no hydration balanceમાં crystals pure solute તથા mother liquor final Tનું saturated solution માનવામાં આવે છે.
  • g solute/100g solventની solubilityથી x=S/(100+S) લો.Hydrated/wet crystalsમાં actual solvent/retained liquor balance કરવું પડે; pure-solute formula બદલાય છે.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. For feed F, crystals C and mother liquor L, F=C+L.
  2. Solute:F xF=C xC+L xL; for pure anhydrous crystals, xC=1.
  3. Substitute L=F−C:C=F(xF−xL)/(xC−xL), then L=F−C.Check solvent balance independently.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Feed F, crystals C, mother liquor Lમાં F=C+L.
  2. Solute F xF=C xC+L xL; pure anhydrous crystalsમાં xC=1.
  3. L=F−Cથી C=F(xF−xL)/(xC−xL); પછી L=F−C; solvent balance અલગ તપાસો.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

F=100kg/h; zF=0.40; xD=0.90; xB=0.10; mass fractions.

To find

Find D and B.

Formula / necessary assumptions

F=D+B; FzF=DxD+BxB.

Calculation

  1. 100=D+B; 40=0.90D+0.10B.
  2. B=100−D; 40=0.90D+10−0.10D.
  3. D=30/0.80=37.5kg/h; B=62.5kg/h.

Final answer

D=37.5kg/h; B=62.5kg/h.

Check

Component check:33.75+6.25=40kg/h.Total=100kg/h.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

F=100kg/h; zF=0.40; xD=0.90; xB=0.10; mass fractions.

શું શોધવું

D/B શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

F=D+B; FzF=DxD+BxB.

ગણતરી

  1. 100=D+B; 40=0.90D+0.10B.
  2. B=100−D; 40=0.90D+10−0.10D.
  3. D=30/0.80=37.5kg/h; B=62.5kg/h.

અંતિમ જવાબ

D=37.5kg/h; B=62.5kg/h.

ચકાસણી

Component:33.75+6.25=40kg/h; total100kg/h.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Gs=100kg carrier/h; Yin=0.10, Yout=0.02kg solute/kg carrier; Ls=200kg solvent/h; Xin=0.

To find

Find solute absorbed and Xout.

Formula / necessary assumptions

Gs(Yin−Yout)=Ls(Xout−Xin); nonvolatile solvent, insoluble carrier, no reaction.

Calculation

  1. Absorbed=100(0.10−0.02)=8kg/h.
  2. 8=200(Xout−0); Xout=0.04kg/kg solvent.
  3. Rich-liquid solute mass fraction=0.04/1.04=0.0384615.

Final answer

8kg/h absorbed; Xout=0.04kg/kg; rich liquid3.846%w/w.

Check

Rich-liquid rate=200+8=208kg/h; gas rate decreases from110to102kg/h.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

Gs=100kg carrier/h; Yin=0.10, Yout=0.02kg solute/kg carrier; Ls=200kg solvent/h; Xin=0.

શું શોધવું

Absorbed solute/Xout શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

Gs(Yin−Yout)=Ls(Xout−Xin); nonvolatile solvent, insoluble carrier, no reaction.

ગણતરી

  1. Absorbed=100(0.10−0.02)=8kg/h.
  2. 8=200(Xout−0); Xout=0.04kg/kg solvent.

Given data

Total solution=solvent+dissolved solute; retained liquor=retention ratio×insoluble mass.

  1. Total solution=100+20=120kg; xsolute=20/120=1/6.

  4. Recovery=13.3333/20×100=66.6667%; residue solute=40/6=6.6667kg.

Final answer

Overflow80kg; wet residue120kg; solute recovery66.667%.

Check

Total80+120=200kg; solute13.3333+6.6667=20kg.The retained liquor is not pure water.

q.en: Define: Unit operations and stoichiometric basis
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: Unit Operations તથા Stoichiometric Basis

a.en: A unit operation is a physical processing step such as separation, mixing or heat-driven phase change.Stoichiometric calculations relate material amounts consistently; reaction stoichiometry uses balanced chemical equations when reaction actually occurs.
a.gu: Separation, mixing કે heat-driven phase change જેવી physical processing step unit operation છે.Stoichiometric ગણતરીઓ amountsને સુસંગત જોડે; reaction થાય ત્યારે balanced equationના coefficients વપરાય.

q.en: Define: General material balance and degrees of freedom
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: General Material Balance તથા Degrees of Freedom

a.en: A material balance accounts for the accumulation, entry, exit, generation and consumption of material inside a defined system boundary.
a.gu: Defined boundaryમાં materialનું accumulation, in, out, generation તથા consumption ગણવું material balance છે.

a.en: Distillation separates liquid-mixture components by differences in volatility through vapour–liquid contacting.

a.en: Absorption transfers a soluble component from a gas into a liquid absorbent.
